arguments.body:
The issue reports that the app crashes on startup after an upgrade. Crash reports are configured to be sent to the incident hook.

Next steps:
- Investigate the crash logs to identify the root cause of the startup crash.
- Verify if recent changes during the upgrade could have introduced the problem.
- Consider rolling back the upgrade if a quick fix isn't possible.
- Monitor the external incident status at https://status.example/incident as indicated.
